text:
amy_sales: POC with Carelyst tomorrow AM. They report streaming responses drop ~30s in from corp network behind proxy: 'Error: socket hang up' or 502. Demo is timeboxed, need triage.
leo_se: Do they have a minimal repro? Node/TS?
amy_sales: Yes TS. They sent this snippet using node-fetch with default agent and timeout 60s.
leo_se: Classic proxy idle kill. Many corporate proxies GC idle upstream conns ~30s. Node default https agent doesn't keep sockets alive for long when streaming.
sam_ops: Ask them to try https-proxy-agent with keepAlive true and extend timeouts client-side. Quick patch:
```
import HttpsProxyAgent from 'https-proxy-agent';
const agent = new HttpsProxyAgent(process.env.HTTPS_PROXY, { keepAlive: true, timeout: 120000 });
await fetch(url, { method: 'POST', body, headers, agent, timeout: 120000 });
```
nina_eng: Also recommended: consume stream as it arrives (pipe) rather than buffering. Some proxies mishandle long chunked streams and force-close.
amy_sales: They say their infra team cannot change proxy rules. Any server-side short-term suggestions for the demo?
nina_eng: Short-term: use the non-streaming (polling) endpoint or decrease max_tokens so generation completes under ~25s. Longer-term: SDK resumable-streaming or gateway-level retry headers to enable safe client retries.
AMY_SALES: (caps) they asked about cost difference streaming vs polling for the demo.
leo_se: For a one-off demo negligible delta. Token billing is per output; polling just waits for final payload. Retries could add token cost if repeated. For production we can advise Optimize settings to lower unit cost.
amy_sales: security note: their security does TLS inspection. Will that break anything?
sam_ops: If MITM, cert pinning could fail; for POC recommend standard TLS w/ HTTPS_PROXY env var and no pinning. Enterprise customers can opt for dedicated Private deployment or mTLS if needed.
deploy-bot: deployment: gateway v1.44.0 rolled at 2026-03-19T22:40:10Z by ci-pipeline (no related proxy config changes).
leo_se: Plan: 1) send agent snippet + increase client timeout to 120s. 2) if still failing, run demo with polling endpoint. 3) follow up to scope SDK resiliency (resumable streams) and gateway retry header.
amy_sales: Customer ok to use polling for tomorrow. I'll send the snippet and a 1-pager about proxy edge cases. Marking triaged. :white_check_mark:
